findings.one_line: The asserted frontier is generated by the specially calibrated equality c_m=C_m=c^{-1}, so the note must position it as a calibration-specific compatibility result and substantiate why it opens a literature-unisolated regime rather than a definitional specialization.

The only exact-rate result is the standard-form armwise plug-in/Assouad match on beta>=gamma, while beta<gamma remains an open bracket; the present comparison does not establish a sharper rate, novel estimand estimator, or previously untreated regime sufficient for the required field-level novelty floor.
